en: As a pastor, I've met a lot of people.

text:
대부분 생각 속에서
온갖 사람들을 다 *평가*합니다
en: Most of them are grading everyone in their heads.
They can't even say "I don't like that."

text:
머리 속을 들어가 보면
온갖 *쓰레기*가 다 들어갔어요
en: Look inside their heads: it's full of garbage.
Judging this one, judging that one.

text:
그렇지 않으면
내가 살 수 없잖아요

en: They should just say it out loud,

text:
그걸 얘기를 안 하고
내가 *착하게* 살았기 때문에
en: but they don't, because they've been "good,"
So in their heads, everyone gets

text:
그 판단한다는 말이
*심판*하다 할 때 단어와
en: That word "judge" is the very same word
In my head, people made in God's image —
I judge them, sentence them, condemn them.
